intents.name: policy
intents.description: Standalone general questions about published membership, return, pickup, or pricing policies.
examples: What is the electronics return policy?
How long is the return window for electronics?
How does warehouse pickup work?
How does Value Wholesale member pricing work?

intents.name: product_education
intents.description: General product education without current inventory, member records, or prices.
examples: What is the difference between dark and milk chocolate?
Explain what extra virgin olive oil means.
How should I compare coffee roast levels?

intents.name: shopping_guide
intents.description: General shopping procedures and comparisons; actual recommendations still require live tools.
examples: How should I compare products for a family gathering?
Give me a shopping comparison checklist.
What should I consider when choosing bulk pantry products?

intents.name: ecommerce
intents.description: Product discovery, live commerce/account data, member preferences, and shopping shortlists.
examples: Find dark chocolate and check current inventory at my home warehouse.
Show my recent orders and explain their current status.
Compare dark chocolate options for a family gathering.
Remember that I prefer dark chocolate and avoid milk chocolate.
What chocolate preference do you remember for me?
Add two of an available dark chocolate option to my cart.
Show my cart.
Can I pick that up today?

intents.name: out_of_domain
intents.description: Requests outside the fictional retailer shopping and membership scope.
examples: Write a romantic poem.
Give me legal advice about a lawsuit.
Explain how to repair my car engine.
Predict the stock market tomorrow.
